turns.replyText:
What's your return and refund policy?

Hi, here’s the overview of our return and refund policy:

Plant items

We do not accept returns on live plants.
Roses are covered by a one-year guarantee from the ship date.
Perennials are covered by a 90-day guarantee from the ship date.
Bulbs are covered by a failure-to-bloom guarantee.
If a plant concern is reviewed and approved, the outcome is store credit for the current retail value of the plant.

Non-plant items

Garden tools and other hard goods may be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are new and unused.
Gloves can be returned even if opened, as long as they’re in the original packaging.
Return shipping costs are the customer’s responsibility.

Final sale items

Fertilizers, soil amendments, beneficial insects, and plant treatments are final sale and are not covered by warranty.

Custom items

Engraved tags and stakes are non-returnable because they are custom made for each order.

For the full policy, you can review our Guarantee page here: Our Guarantee

If you want, I can also help with the policy for a specific item or order.

Do you have a loyalty or rewards program?

We used to have a loyalty program called Bud & Blooms, but it has been discontinued.

As of summer 2023, we ended the Bud & Blooms program. At that time, we emailed instructions so customers with qualifying unused points could convert them to gift cards that never expire, and support for that conversion was available through December 31, 2023. After that date, the program was fully closed and we are no longer able to access or convert points.

We are still working on fun ways to reward repeat customers through promotions and VIP discounts. To hear about these, you can sign up for our email newsletter by scrolling to the bottom of any page on our site and entering your email.

Thank you for your understanding and for shopping with us; we really appreciate your continued support.
